section: # -- client_spending.csv: Core spending, mortgage/housing costs, rent, and travel/extra expenses.

label: annual_spending_base_year
notes: Base year; excludes taxes and mortgage

label: core_spending_growth_mode
notes: cpi | manual_override; Choose whether core spending increases with general CPI or a manual spending-specific rate.

label: core_spending_manual_growth_rate
notes: Annual core-spending increase used only when core_spending_growth_mode is manual_override.

label: ytd_remainder_spending_override
notes: Optional: override the projected remainder-of-year CORE spending (after actual YTD core spending; excludes housing/wellness/travel/large discretionary) instead of a linear pro-rated estimate. Leave blank to use the linear estimate.

label: ytd_blend_enabled
notes: TRUE blends real YTD actuals (income/spending tracked this year) into the current-year projection (recommended). FALSE models this plan as fully hypothetical, ignoring real-world actuals tracked elsewhere in this workspace. Does not affect the always-on investment growth/contribution date proration.

label: qcd_enabled
notes: Enable Qualified Charitable Distributions: each member's own IRA can send money straight to charity, excluded from AGI, once age 70 1/2-eligible.

label: h_qcd_annual_amount
notes: Member 1's annual QCD amount. Capped at that year's own RMD (phase-1 scope) and at the statutory per-person QCD limit.

label: w_qcd_annual_amount
notes: Member 2's annual QCD amount. Capped at that year's own RMD (phase-1 scope) and at the statutory per-person QCD limit.

label: h_qcd_start_year
notes: Optional override for the first year Member 1's QCD applies. Blank = the year they turn age 70 1/2-eligible.

label: h_qcd_end_year
notes: Optional last year Member 1's QCD applies. Blank = continues through plan end.

label: w_qcd_start_year
notes: Optional override for the first year Member 2's QCD applies. Blank = the year they turn age 70 1/2-eligible.

label: w_qcd_end_year
notes: Optional last year Member 2's QCD applies. Blank = continues through plan end.

label: last_payment_year
notes: Model stops mortgage in this year

label: annual_real_estate_taxes
notes: Annual real-estate/property tax cash-flow amount; shown with Mortgage and RE Tax instead of core spending.

label: real_estate_tax_annual_adjustment_pct
notes: Annual percentage adjustment applied to real-estate/property taxes in the cash-flow forecast.

label: monthly_rent_post_sale
notes: Active from home_sale_year; inflated with CPI; hidden from UI/workbook when zero
